plugins.name: qoq
plugins.description: Guarded delivery loop and quality gate for JavaScript/TypeScript repos — `fix`, `refactor`, `bump`, `plan`, `replan`, `execute`, `test`, `compress`, `document`, `mermaid`, `sheriff`, `review`, `feedback`. Use it whenever the user wants lint or formatting cleaned up, dead code or dependencies removed, a branch checked before merge, duplication refactored, npm dependencies bumped or their vulnerabilities fixed, a spec broken into tickets, a stalled plan reshaped, an approved plan executed or resumed (from a plan file or a Jira, Linear or Trello milestone), tests written for existing code, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md or skill docs made terser, the why behind code written down as JSDoc and `./docs`, a Mermaid diagram drawn, a change checked for security problems a linter can't see, a delivery or pull request checked against its plan or description, or feedback about qoq sent to its maintainers. Trigger it even when the user never says "qoq" or names a tool.

plugins.name: qoq-fullstack
plugins.description: Chief of staff for one feature that spans several repos — an API and a UI, two APIs and a front end, any set of qoq-based JavaScript/TypeScript repos in one parent folder. `plan` grills the business side only into a Given/When/Then BRD with master milestones, then has each repo write its own `qoq plan` in its own background session; `execute` runs every repo's plan in parallel, one session per repo, unblocking a repo only when the milestone it depends on is delivered and each master milestone only when its integration check passes; `status` shows where the feature stands. Use it whenever the user wants a cross-repo or full-stack feature planned or delivered, a scrum of scrums, a master plan over several repos, or parallel per-repo plans coordinated — even if they never say "fullstack".
